mapper.sql: case when u.lock_yn = 'Y' and (u.locked_until is null or u.locked_until > now()) then 'Y' else 'N' end
mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.comp_cd, u.login_id, u.user_nm, u.pwd_hash, u.locale_cd, as lock_yn, u.pwd_change_req_yn, u.use_yn, c.status_cd as comp_status_cd, c.use_yn as comp_use_yn, u.user_type, u.cust_id, (select mc.use_yn from mst_cust mc where mc.cust_id = u.cust_id) as cust_use_yn from sys_user u join sys_comp c on c.comp_cd = u.comp_cd where u.comp_cd = #{compCd} and lower(u.login_id) = lower(#{loginId})
select from sys_user u where u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: with cur as ( select u.user_id, (case when u.lock_yn = 'Y' then 0 else u.login_fail_cnt end) + 1 as next_cnt from sys_user u where u.user_id = #{userId} and = 'N' ) update sys_user s set login_fail_cnt = cur.next_cnt, lock_yn = case when cur.next_cnt >= #{maxLoginFail} then 'Y' else 'N' end, locked_until = case when cur.next_cnt >= #{maxLoginFail} then now() + make_interval(mins => #{lockMinutes}) else null end, updated_at = now(), updated_by = 'LOGIN' from cur where s.user_id = cur.user_id
update sys_user set login_fail_cnt = 0, lock_yn = 'N', locked_until = null, last_login_at = now() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from sys_user u join sys_comp c on c.comp_cd = u.comp_cd where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.use_yn = 'Y' and not (u.lock_yn = 'Y' and u.locked_until is null) and (u.session_not_before is null or u.session_not_before <= #{loginAt}) and c.status_cd = 'ACTIVE' and c.use_yn = 'Y' and (u.user_type = 'INTERNAL' or exists (select 1 from mst_cust mc where mc.cust_id = u.cust_id and mc.use_yn = 'Y'))
mapper.update: update sys_user set pwd_hash = #{pwdHash}, pwd_changed_at = now(), pwd_change_req_yn = 'N', login_fail_cnt = 0, updated_at = now(), updated_by = 'SELF' where user_id = #{userId}
